headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of September 1, 2026, the portfolio set is showing an average return of 25.28%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark, which has a return of 12.46%. This results in an average alpha of 12.82%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 47.11%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 10.54%, but still maintains a positive performance relative to SPY. This outperformance is particularly notable during a period of macro uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's strength in challenging market conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
